+# mypy: allow-untyped-defs
+"""Plugin distribution names and versions, without abbreviation."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def full_plugin_versions(plugininfo) -> list[str]:
+    """Return the unique ``name-version`` strings of the plugin distributions.
+
+    Like :func:`_pytest.terminal._plugin_nameversions`, but keeps the
+    ``pytest-`` prefix so the complete distribution names are reported.
+    """
+    values: list[str] = []
+    for plugin, dist in plugininfo:
+        name = f"{dist.project_name}-{dist.version}"
+        # A distribution can provide more than one plugin.
+        if name not in values:
+            values.append(name)
+    return values

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+from _pytest.full_plugin_versions import full_plugin_versions
+import pytest
+
+
+class DistInfo(NamedTuple):
+    project_name: str
+    version: int
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "input,expected",
+    [
+        ([], []),
+        ([DistInfo(project_name="test", version=1)], ["test-1"]),
+        ([DistInfo(project_name="pytest-test", version=1)], ["pytest-test-1"]),
+        (
+            [
+                DistInfo(project_name="test", version=1),
+                DistInfo(project_name="test", version=1),
+            ],
+            ["test-1"],
+        ),
+        (
+            [
+                DistInfo(project_name="pytest-b", version=2),
+                DistInfo(project_name="a", version=1),
+                DistInfo(project_name="pytest-b", version=2),
+            ],
+            ["pytest-b-2", "a-1"],
+        ),
+    ],
+    ids=["empty", "normal", "prefix-kept", "deduplicate", "order-preserved"],
+)
+def test_full_plugin_versions(input: list[DistInfo], expected: list[str]) -> None:
+    pluginlist = [(None, x) for x in input]
+    assert full_plugin_versions(pluginlist) == expected
+
+
+def test_full_plugin_versions_accepts_iterator() -> None:
+    pluginlist = iter([(None, DistInfo(project_name="pytest-x", version=3))])
+    assert full_plugin_versions(pluginlist) == ["pytest-x-3"]
+
+
+def test_full_plugin_versions_propagates_errors() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        full_plugin_versions([(None, object())])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        full_plugin_versions([(None,)])
